title: Interactive rebase
notes:
## Steps

1. Pick the first commit
2. Squash the rest

| Key | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| p   | pick    |
| s   | squash  | const answer: number = 42 graph TD
  A[Start] --> B[Rebase] <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10"/></svg> https://example.com/diagram.png main = putStrLn "unknown language, kept as written" print("alias for python")
notes_markdown:
## Steps

1. Pick the first commit
2. Squash the rest

| Key | Meaning |
| --- | ------- |
| p   | pick    |
| s   | squash  |

```typescript
const answer: number = 42
```

```json
{
  "retries": 3,
  "hosts": [
    "a",
    "b"
  ]
}
```

![](https://mermaid.ink/img/Z3JhcGggVEQKICBBW1N0YXJ0XSAtLT4gQltSZWJhc2VdCg?type=png&bgColor=fff "Mermaid Diagram")

*Source: `cheats.yml`*
raw_yaml:
title: Interactive rebase
cheat: git rebase -i HEAD~3
tags:
  - git
notes:
  md: |
    ## Steps

    1. Pick the first commit
    2. Squash the rest

    | Key | Meaning |
    | --- | ------- |
    | p   | pick    |
    | s   | squash  |
  ts: "const answer: number = 42"
  json:
    retries: 3
    hosts:
      - a
      - b
  mermaid: |
    graph TD
      A[Start] --> B[Rebase]
  svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><rect
    width="10" height="10"/></svg>
  img: https://example.com/diagram.png
  haskell: main = putStrLn "unknown language, kept as written"
  py: print("alias for python")
